findings.verifierReasoning: The source imposes a hard monetary ceiling of $25,000,000 per year on the combined aggregate of the two carveouts in clauses (i) and (ii). The proposed IR represents this solely as a LEDGER_USAGE_REFERENCE to a sharedCapId (ir-sharedcap:d2b4cbcee3b8fca7ba82e628), but no shared-cap resource is defined anywhere in the IR (definitions is empty). Consequently, the actual numeric cap of $25,000,000 and the per-year periodicity are entirely absent from the compiled representation. A user consulting this IR cannot determine the permitted aggregate amount, so the capacity-limiting effect of the source is lost. This is an omission, not merely a formatting defect, and it directly affects the ability to compute compliance. Because the IR claims COMPLETE sufficiency for both rules, the omission is especially consequential.
